```{python}
#| label: datos-base

from pathlib import Path
import sys
ROOT = Path.cwd()
if not (ROOT / "src").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from src.data import lake_reader
from src.ml import modelos
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

ultima_fecha = lake_reader.listar_fechas_disponibles("serving", "indicador_diario")[-1]
base = lake_reader.leer_indicador_diario(ultima_fecha)

OMS = {"Buena": "#2d6a4f", "Moderada": "#ee9b00", "Dañina (sensible)": "#ca6702",
       "Dañina": "#bb3e03", "Muy dañina": "#9d0208", "Peligrosa": "#6a040f"}

def f1(x, dec=1):
    return "s/d" if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and pd.isna(x)) else f"{x:.{dec}f}"

def entero(x):
    return "s/d" if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and pd.isna(x)) else f"{x:,.0f}"
```

## 01 · Estado de hoy

```{python}
#| label: kpis
#| output: asis
pm = base["pm25_media"].dropna()
lat = base[base["region"] == "LatAm"]["pm25_media"].dropna()
sobre = base[base["pm25_media"] > 35.4].shape[0]
pmax = base.loc[base["pm25_media"].idxmax()] if not pm.empty else None

def card(valor, unidad, etiqueta, clase="kpi-aire"):
    return (f'<div class="kpi {clase}"><div class="kpi-valor">{valor}'
            f'<span class="kpi-unidad">{unidad}</span></div>'
            f'<div class="kpi-etiqueta">{etiqueta}</div></div>')

cards = [
    card(f1(pm.median()), "µg/m³", "PM2.5 mediana · global"),
    card(f1(lat.median()), "µg/m³", "PM2.5 mediana · LatAm"),
    card(str(sobre), "puntos", "Sobre 35.4 µg/m³ (límite diario laxo)"),
    card(f1(pmax["pm25_media"]) if pmax is not None else "s/d", "µg/m³",
         f'Peor punto · {pmax["ciudad"]}' if pmax is not None else "Peor punto"),
]
print('<div class="kpi-row">' + "".join(cards) + "</div>")
```

## 02 · Machine Learning — Clasificación de calidad del aire

```{python}
#| label: ml-clasificacion-aire
#| output: asis
from src.ml import modelos
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.express as px

# Preparar datos para clasificación de categoría OMS
feat_cols = ["pm25_media", "pm10_media", "o3_media", "no2_media", "so2_media", "co_media"]
df_ml = base.dropna(subset=feat_cols + ["categoria_pm25_aqi"]).copy()

if len(df_ml) > 20:
    X = df_ml[feat_cols].values.astype(float)
    y_raw = df_ml["categoria_pm25_aqi"].values
    clases = sorted(df_ml["categoria_pm25_aqi"].unique())

    # Codificar etiquetas a enteros
    le = LabelEncoder()
    y = le.fit_transform(y_raw)

    # Split train/test con stratify
    try:
        Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
    except ValueError:
        Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)

    # Entrenar Random Forest de scikit-learn
    clf = modelos.RandomForestClassifier(n_arboles=100, max_depth=8, seed=42, class_weight="balanced")
    clf.fit(Xtr, ytr)
    ypred = clf.predict(Xte)

    acc = float((ypred == yte).mean())
    print("<div class='ml-card'>")
    print(f"<h3>Random Forest (scikit-learn) — Clasificación categoría OMS</h3>")
    print(f"<p>Exactitud: <b>{acc:.1%}</b> · puntos entrenados: <b>{len(df_ml)}</b> · clases: {clases}</p>")
    print("</div>")

    # Matriz de confusión
    cm = confusion_matrix(yte, ypred)
    fig_cm = go.Figure(data=go.Heatmap(
        z=cm,
        x=[f"Pred: {c}" for c in clases],
        y=[f"Real: {c}" for c in clases],
        colorscale="Greens",
        showscale=True,
    ))
    fig_cm.update_layout(title="Matriz de confusión — Categoría OMS", height=400,
                         margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=60, b=40))
    fig_cm.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False})

    # Importancia de features
    imp = pd.DataFrame({
        "contaminante": feat_cols,
        "importancia": clf.feature_importances_()
    }).sort_values("importancia", ascending=True)
    fig_imp = px.bar(imp, x="importancia", y="contaminante", orientation="h",
                     title="Importencia de variables — Clasificación de calidad del aire",
                     color_discrete_sequence=["#ee9b00"])
    fig_imp.update_layout(height=300, margin=dict(l=80, r=20, t=50, b=40))
    fig_imp.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False})

    # Predicción vs real scatter
    fig_pred = go.Figure()
    fig_pred.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=yte, y=ypred, mode="markers",
        marker=dict(color="#ee9b00", size=8, opacity=0.7),
        name="Predicción"
    ))
    fig_pred.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=[0, len(clases)-1], y=[0, len(clases)-1], mode="lines",
        line=dict(dash="dash", color="#6c757d"), name="Diagonal"
    ))
    fig_pred.update_layout(
        title="Clase real vs predicha (categoría OMS)",
        xaxis=dict(tickmode="array", tickvals=list(range(len(clases))), ticktext=clases, title="Real"),
        yaxis=dict(tickmode="array", tickvals=list(range(len(clases))), ticktext=clases, title="Predicha"),
        height=400, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=60, b=40)
    )
    fig_pred.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False})
else:
    print("<div class='callout-warning'>Datos insuficientes para entrenar el clasificador ML.</div>")
```

## 03 · Análisis de contaminantes y perfiles por ciudad

```{python}
#| label: graficos-aire
top = base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]).sort_values("pm25_media", ascending=False).head(20)
fig1 = px.bar(top, x="pm25_media", y="ciudad", color="categoria_pm25_aqi",
              color_discrete_map=OMS, title="Top 20 PM2.5 (µg/m³) · bandas AQI",
              labels={"pm25_media": "PM2.5 media", "ciudad": "Ciudad"})
fig1.add_vline(x=15, line_dash="dash", line_color="#2d6a4f",
               annotation_text="Guía OMS 24h: 15 µg/m³")
fig1.update_layout(height=480, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
fig1.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})

fig2 = px.histogram(base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]), x="pm25_media", color="region",
                    nbins=30, title="Distribución de PM2.5 por región",
                    labels={"pm25_media": "PM2.5 µg/m³"})
fig2.add_vline(x=15, line_dash="dash", line_color="#2d6a4f",
               annotation_text="Guía OMS 24h: 15 µg/m³")
fig2.update_layout(height=380, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
fig2.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})

# Correlación entre contaminantes
cols_cont = ["pm25_media", "pm10_media", "o3_media", "no2_media", "so2_media", "co_media", "us_aqi_max"]
corr = base[cols_cont].corr()
fig3 = go.Figure(data=go.Heatmap(
    z=corr.values,
    x=cols_cont,
    y=cols_cont,
    colorscale="RdBu",
    zmid=0,
    colorbar=dict(title="Correlación"),
))
fig3.update_layout(title="Matriz de correlación — Contaminantes y AQI",
                   height=500, margin=dict(l=80, r=20, t=60, b=80))
fig3.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False})
```

> Bandas de color: breakpoints del AQI (EPA EE. UU.). Línea verde: guía OMS 2021 (PM2.5 24h ≤ 15 µg/m³). Bandas calculadas en `src/transform/indicadores.py`. ML implementado con scikit-learn (clasificación categoría OMS) y `src/ml/modelos.py` (backend scikit-learn).
